# Cost Explorer responses

JSON bodies of Cost Explorer's answers, for the tests (`stub_cost_explorer` in
`test/test_helper.rb` and the moto tests). They follow the response syntax of
the API reference for `GetCostAndUsage` and `GetCostForecast`; they are not
recorded from an account (docs/setup.md#tests). Today is 2026-11-10 (UTC) in
all of them.
